performance.evidence: The e15 test plan defines no fixed latency, throughput, or project-size threshold.

reliability.evidence: Atomic destination write locks, dead PID recovery, crash/disk-full resilience, fail-closed packet schema/integrity validation, strict symlink and path traversal containment, command/payload idempotency, transactional two-phase DB/artifact stage and swap rollback, and transitive dependency deletion with durable tombstones and not-recalled disclosure preservation passed under Node.js 24.

operability.evidence: Export and backup packets, inspection manifests, non-destructive restore drills, command registries, evidence tombstones, and deletion events are inspectable through typed APIs and persisted SQLite records.

epic_scenarios.evidence: All 20 planned e15 scenarios are covered across e15s01, e15s02, e15s03, e15s04, and e15s05 integration suites.

project_gates.evidence: npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run build, npm test, preflight, blind-spot, and completeness checks passed after verification evidence was persisted.
